params.prompt: A clean, premium price-offer graphic on a flat warm off-white (#FBF6EF) background. Top-right: a simple deep-indigo (#241E4E) rounded price-tag shape reserved for a struck-through "₹499 → ₹199" price overlay (leave that tag area visually blank/simple — text added separately). Center-left: a single closed hardcover document/booklet rendered as flat gold (#C9A227) line-art icon (a simple rectangle with a bookmark ribbon, NOT an open book, NOT any architecture), floating at a slight angle with a soft drop shadow. Generous clean negative space in the lower third for a CTA button overlay. Flat 2D vector graphic design only, premium fintech-offer aesthetic, calm and trustworthy.
